reviewer_type: independent AI agent; not human annotation or human validation
model_identity_available_in_session: Codex, described as based on GPT-6; exact runtime model identifier unavailable and not guessed

reviewed_scope.reason: Parent narrowed scope to first 100 rows; remaining rows assigned to another blinded reviewer.

blinding.independence: No delegation and no access to other reviewers judgments. Full source row-count/dataset/field-length metadata enumerated initially; substantive review restricted to A0000-A0099.

method: Manually inspected source batches and manually authored every five-label row and rationale. Source display compacted whitespace and decoded embedded cell_record JSON strings for inspection. Recursive raw/reference differences and standard Python JSON parsing plus official jsonschema validation were objective aids, not semantic annotation rules. JSON fragments inside Python programs or prematurely closed/unfinished parent answers were not accepted as full intended JSON.

decision_policy.labels: yes means error; no means no error; not-assessable means evidence insufficient.
decision_policy.completion: Semantic interruption required: unfinished tokens/values count; finished substantive answers with missing/extra delimiters alone do not.
decision_policy.syntax: Assessed full intended JSON after removal of surrounding prose/fences only, without repair.
decision_policy.envelope_contamination: Literal surrounding prose/fences count even when a two-part natural-language format was requested.
decision_policy.schema_non_conformance: Only actual supplied schema field used, parsed safely via ast.literal_eval and checked with jsonschema. No schema synthesized from gold or prompt shape. Invalid full intended JSON gives not-assessable.
decision_policy.content_fidelity: Judged meaningful correctness against source prompt and reference evidence; decoded records and coordinate/value correspondence inspected. Harmless allergy capitalization and unambiguous added nesting do not by themselves imply content error. Unsupported additional medication identities without source prompt remain not-assessable. Invalid full intended JSON gives not-assessable despite visible partial faults.

limitations: AI judgments are not human validation and may retain subjective semantic errors.
53 of 100 prompts are absent and 64 of 100 supplied schema fields are absent.
Reference answers can be incomplete or imperfect; differences alone were not treated as sufficient evidence of semantic error.
Long prompts were viewed selectively around task input and relevant constraints; unrelated few-shot examples were not relied upon as task evidence.
The 130 rows after A0099 are outside this reviewers substantive review scope.
